text:
I shortened the title of the dictation-v3 proposal, and `node Server/text-check.mjs` flagged nothing. The old title ran 31 words. The new one is "Web dictation V3: show replies and live words, pause the fast seat, merge read-aloud (you are a mastermind)".

I left the rest of the proposal alone. The owner asks are short bullets and the "Do" section is brief. I logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`.

Two small things I did not change. `voice-assistant` and `audio/Recite` in the proposal are plain text rather than links. I also didn't screenshot it, since a proposal has no `page.js`.
